Booking questions

A clear answer
before you decide.

Does permanent makeup hurt?+

Most clients feel pressure or scratching rather than pain. Topical numbing is used where appropriate and comfort is checked throughout.

How long does PMU last?+

It is semi-permanent and fades gradually. Most treatments last about 1 to 3 years, depending on the treatment, skin, sun exposure and aftercare.

What happens while it heals?+

Pigment appears darker at first and softens as it heals. Aftercare guidance covers the first healing phase and what to avoid.

Can I train with no experience?+

Foundation training begins with core theory and technique practice. Check licensing, insurance and registration requirements for your location before professional practice.
